seo.title: Website Development Process — Ernest Makarov
seo.description: A clear website development process covering discovery, strategy, structure, design, development, testing and launch.

description: A clear process without chaos: you always know what is happening now and what comes next.
visualAlt: Layers representing the modern website creation process

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: We discuss the challenge, audience, business goals and the result the website should deliver.
discovery.result: A clear objective and project direction

strategy.title: Strategy and structure
strategy.description: I define priorities, organise the pages and build a clear user journey towards the desired action.
strategy.result: A sitemap and clear user journey

design.title: Design
design.description: I create the visual direction, interface and responsive screens that reflect the character of the business.

development.title: Development
development.description: I turn the design into a fast responsive website and add animations, forms and the required functionality.

testing.title: Testing
testing.description: I check different devices, performance, links, forms and the complete user journey.
testing.result: A tested website ready to publish

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: I connect the domain, configure deployment and deliver everything required for future use.
launch.result: The website published on your domain

cta.note: A short message is enough to begin — no lengthy brief required.

questions.description: I do not start designing blindly. First, I ask a few questions that reveal the business, the customer and the website's real purpose.

items.audience: Who is your target audience and what genuinely matters to them?
items.clients: How do new customers currently find you and make a decision?
items.difference: What makes your business stronger or more distinctive than competitors?
items.action: What is the main action a visitor should take on the website?
items.visual: Which colours, mood and visual references feel right for your brand?
items.materials: Which materials are already available and when is the result needed?

questions.footer: You do not need to prepare the answers in advance. We will work through every point together and define a clear direction.
